sql: SELECT * FROM transfers WHERE idempotency_key = $1
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM wallets WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total FROM transfers WHERE from_wallet_id = $1 AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
INSERT INTO transfers (from_wallet_id, to_wallet_id, amount, fee, status, idempotency_key) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING *
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transfer_id, wallet_id, direction, kind, amount) VALUES ($1, $2, 'debit', 'transfer', $3), ($1, $2, 'debit', 'fee', $4)
UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance - $2 WHERE id = $1
UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance + $2 WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transfer_id, wallet_id, direction, kind, amount) VALUES ($1, $2, 'credit', 'transfer', $3)
COMMIT
SELECT * FROM wallets WHERE id = $1
